char_5.name: Blood Scarred Orc
char_5.flavor: A hardened veteran of a hundred surface raids.

char_6.name: The Shadow Priest
char_6.flavor: Chanter of the dark litanies and keeper of secrets.

DECK_JSON.prompt: An old Orc with <jagged/deep/angry> scars stumbles in. He says he's seen more [[Sun-King]] blood than you've seen gold. Let him stay?
The torches <flicker/dim/turn blue>. A man in hooded robes steps from the shadows of the [[Catacombs]]. He smells of <rot/incense>.

dialogues.btn: What did he try to steal?
dialogues.text: A single copper coin. The <audacity/nerve> is what exhausts me.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I caught a surface thief <sneaking/hiding> into the lower vaults. Flay him?

dialogues.text: Soft as <butter/maggots>. But they have shiny spears.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I remember the layout of the [[Sun-King]]’s armory. Give me 100 men and I’ll bring back <steel/iron/spoils>.

nextCard.cardText: The raid was a success. The guards fought <fiercely/hard>, but I brought back steel. I am only missing half my jaw.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My old wounds <ache/burn>. The winter is cold. I need the [[Shadow Priest]]‘s dark magic to fight.
Found some surface <grog/ale>. It makes the boyz fight harder… and die <faster/sooner>.
I’ve survived eighty raids, but new recruits keep <polishing/cleaning> armor instead of sharpening axes. Can I flay them?
An elf shot me in the kidney with a <glowing/magic> arrow. I kept it as a torch. Can I have a <sick day/rest>?
The new recruits don’t even know how to properly <sever/cut> a limb! They need live practice.
Back in my day, we didn’t have ‘healing potions.’ We rubbed <dirt/mud> in our wounds! Ban the potions.

dialogues.text: No… it just has a very good <battle-cry/scream>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I found an orphaned human baby during the raid. It looked at me… and <didn’t cry/laughed>.
My axe is rusted dull, but it holds the blood of a hundred <kings/heroes>. The smith wants to melt it.
My Bruisers are getting soft. They want ‘Participation Trophies’ for every village burned. Should I <flay/beat> the sentiment out of them?

dialogues.text: Only when we breathe. Or swing an axe. Or <exist/move>.

nextCard.cardText: The rusted Bruisers are now invincible, but they are so heavy they accidentally crush a dozen goblins just walking to the latrine.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Our armor is rusting directly into our flesh. To peel it off means <flaying/pain>. To leave it means we move like stone.
I am feeling nostalgic. Let me recreate my first raid by setting fire to the Swarm’s favorite [[Fungus Farms]].

dialogues.text: A solid pair of boots won’t plot to <overthrow/kill> you.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I’ve seen three Dark Lords fall. They all started with golden statues and ended as <charcoal/ash>. Maybe we just buy better boots instead?

dialogues.text: It smells like mushroom soup and profound <disrespect/shame>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The young ones are using my legendary axe to chop ‘Death-Cap’ fungus. <Flay/Punish> them for me, or I walk.

dialogues.btn: Where do we find a prince?
dialogues.text: I have procured a <coupon/pardon> for the local kingdom’s royal nursery.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The dark altar requires a sacrifice of <royal/blue> blood to awaken the old ones.
The stars align in a bloody crescent. We must sacrifice the <plumpest/fattest> goblins tonight.
I can bind the <screaming/lost> souls of fallen heroes to our [[Vanguard]]’s armor. It requires a tithe of gold.
The ethereal whispers from the <deep abyss/void> are amplifying. Should I answer them?
The Abyss demands a virgin sacrifice, but there is a <blizzard/storm> outside. Can we just use a particularly pure goblin?
I accidentally summoned a lesser demon of <misplaced/lost> items. Now all the armory keys are missing.

nextCard.cardText: Smashing the doors triggered the arcane wards. The armory is open, but half the Vanguard is permanently <singed/burnt>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: [[The Deep Flame]] is hungry, but the sacrificial pits are closed for a ‘Mandatory Safety <Inspection/Audit>’.
I have started a ‘Book Club’ reading the Necronomicon. The goblins are <taking to it/learning> surprisingly well.

dialogues.text: We tried. The plunger was consumed, along with the <plumber/goblin>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Tentacles are erupting from the <plumbing/drains> again. The plumbers require exorbitant hazard pay.

dialogues.text: The Abyss forecloses on our mortal <coils/souls>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The dark gods demand a ‘[[Soul-Taxes|Void Tax]].’ 20% of all shiny rocks must be <thrown/tossed> into the abyss.
My resonant chanting is causing the <stalactites/rocks> to fall and crush the workers. Should I hum instead?
[[The Deep Flame]] is flickering. I suggest we toss in the ‘Employee of the Month’ to <brighten/warm> the mood.

nextCard.cardText: LUNCH WAS ADEQUATE. I AM PLEASED. I DEMAND DESSERT.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I suggest we replace the torches with ‘[[Grave-Wax]] Candles.’ They smell of ancient rot and provide a most becoming <gloom/darkness>.
I have curated a ‘Gallery of Agony’. It is merely Goblins attempting basic <math/logic>. It is my masterpiece.
I am profoundly bored. The Abyss demands a sacrifice, or a very long, very dry lecture on the <philosophy/concept> of nothingness.
The [[Dungeon Merchant]] is selling ‘Sacrificial Indulgences’ to the Swarm. For ten gold, a goblin is exempt from rituals. I am <furious/angry>.
The Abyss is whisper-quiet today. I fear it is pouting. Should I toss in a dozen of your elite Bruisers to <cheer it up/feed it>, or will you surrender the gold vault?
